Name: Guató
Location: Lakes Gaíba and Uberaba, upper Paraguay river (Mato Grosso, Brazil)
Remark: Recorded by Max Schmidt in October-November 1901 (three weeks among the Guató of the Gaíba and Uberaba lakes); words fixed by pointing at objects/actions and checked afterwards with the Guató woman Rosa through Portuguese. Schmidt's own forms only; the Castelnau 1851 forms he interleaves are excluded.
